<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that breaks an alkyl halide and forms a tertiary amine (N‑alkylation). This corresponds to the forward reaction where a secondary amine is alkylated with an alkyl halide to give a tertiary amine.</thought>

  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["tertiary amines"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
